equation_name: Energy at sample after throughput losses
equation_text: E_eff = E_p * eta_SLM * eta_filter * eta_pupil * eta_transmission
inputs_required: E_p [J]; eta_SLM (default 0.7); eta_filter (from Engine 1); eta_pupil (from objective clipping); eta_transmission (optics — default 1.0)
calibration_required: no — eta_SLM and eta_transmission need measurement for absolute accuracy
validity_limits: Assumes static efficiency; does not account for thermal lensing or time-varying losses
notes: eta_SLM and eta_transmission should be measured for quantitative fluence predictions; defaults give order-of-magnitude estimate

equation_text: U(x y z) = IFFT2{ FFT2{U(x y 0)} * exp(i k_z z) } with BL-ASM bandlimit applied
inputs_required: U(x y z=0) [complex field]; k [wavenumber]; grid (N x N; dx; dz)
outputs_produced: U(x y z) [complex field at propagated plane]
validity_limits: Paraxial approximation: cone half-angle gamma < ~15°. Field must not reach grid boundary. BL-ASM bandlimit must be satisfied
notes: Validated by characterisation lock — core Engine 1 equation; no calibration needed

equation_name: Spatial fluence map from normalised field and pulse energy
equation_text: F(x y z) = E_eff * |U(x y z)|^2 / 1e4 [J/cm^2]
inputs_required: U(x y z) normalised field [m^-2]; E_eff [J]
calibration_required: no — analytical scaling; requires E_eff accuracy
validity_limits: Field must be normalised so integral of |U|^2 dA = 1. Valid for linear propagation regime only (P << P_crit)
notes: Conversion factor 1e4 converts from J/m^2 to J/cm^2; normalisation is critical for absolute accuracy

equation_name: Ratio of local fluence to threshold fluence
equation_text: R_th(x y) = F(x y) / F_th_N where F_th_N = F_th(1) * N^(S-1)
inputs_required: F(x y z) [J/cm^2]; F_th(1) [J/cm^2]; S [incubation exponent]; N [shot count]
calibration_required: yes — F_th(1) and S must be calibrated
validity_limits: F_th from literature is prior only; R_th is a proxy until calibrated; F_th must match wavelength / pulse duration / NA / sample
notes: Literature F_th gives order-of-magnitude; local calibration gives calibrated prediction status

inputs_required: F_th(1) [J/cm^2]; S [dimensionless exponent]; N [integer shot count]
calibration_required: yes — S and F_th(1) must be calibrated for this material
validity_limits: S < 1 (incubation decreases threshold with N). Valid functional form is well-established; parameter values are material-specific
notes: Jee-Becker functional form is the standard in the field. S=1 means no incubation (no N dependence). Use S=0.85 as placeholder prior only

inputs_required: v [m/s scan speed]; f_rep [Hz repetition rate]
validity_limits: Valid for linear scan at constant speed; not valid for acceleration/deceleration phases
notes: Simple geometry; no physics beyond kinematics

equation_name: Number of pulses within one beam spot diameter
inputs_required: r_core [m beam core radius at surface]; d_pulse [m pulse spacing]
validity_limits: Uses r_core as the beam radius — for Bessel beam use measured or predicted core radius
notes: N_spot determines effective incubation N at each site for continuous scanning; larger N_spot means more incubation

equation_name: Fluence dose delivered per unit scan length
equation_text: dD/dl = E_eff * f_rep / v [J/m per m] = E_eff * f_rep / v
validity_limits: Valid for uniform scan at constant speed
notes: Useful for quick estimate of line dose without full spatial simulation

equation_name: Cumulative fluence after N shots at trajectory positions
equation_text: F_cum(x y) = sum_{i=1}^{N_total} F(x - x_i; y - y_i)
inputs_required: F(x y) [fluence map per shot]; {x_i; y_i} [shot positions along trajectory]
validity_limits: Geometric accumulation only — no heat or incubation coupling in this equation
notes: This is the raw geometric dose. Does NOT account for heat accumulation or shot-to-shot modification buildup. Model status is explicitly dose_accumulation_proxy

equation_name: K-photon absorption rate proxy for energy deposition
equation_text: W_K ~ sigma_K * I^K where sigma_K is K-photon cross section and K = ceil(E_g / E_photon)
inputs_required: I [W/m^2 intensity]; sigma_K [m^(2K)/W^(K-1) K-photon cross section]; K [photon order]
calibration_required: yes — sigma_K is material-specific and essentially unknown for Cr:ZnSe at our conditions
validity_limits: Valid only as qualitative proxy. K = ceil(2.4 eV / 1.2 eV) = 2 for ZnSe at 1030 nm — approximately 2-photon process
notes: Explicitly a nonlinear_deposition_proxy — not a calibrated model. sigma_K for Cr:ZnSe at 1030 nm must be measured or computed from band structure

equation_name: Rate equation for free carrier density (proxy)
inputs_required: W_K [m^-3 s^-1 generation rate]; N_e [m^-3 carrier density]; tau_rec [s recombination time]
calibration_required: yes — sigma_K and tau_rec are material-specific and uncalibrated for our system
validity_limits: Simplified rate equation; ignores impact ionisation; avalanche ionisation; Drude dynamics; only first-order removal term
notes: Proxy only — tau_rec for ZnSe ~0.1–10 ps (literature estimate); actual value unknown

equation_name: Characteristic length for heat diffusion between pulses
validity_limits: Assumes 1D heat diffusion between uniformly spaced pulses; 3D effects and geometry not included
notes: D_th for ZnSe ~1e-5 m^2/s → L_th ~ sqrt(1e-5/50000) ~ 14 µm at 50 kHz. Much larger than in glass → heat dissipates faster

equation_name: Simplified heat equation proxy for peak temperature rise
equation_text: delta_T_proxy ~ F_abs / (rho * Cp * z_abs) where F_abs = F * alpha_abs and z_abs ~ 1/alpha_abs
inputs_required: F [J/cm^2 absorbed fluence]; rho [kg/m^3]; Cp [J/kg/K]; alpha_abs [m^-1 absorption coefficient]
calibration_required: yes — alpha_abs (nonlinear absorption at focus) is uncalibrated
validity_limits: Assumes all absorbed energy deposited in thin slab of thickness 1/alpha_abs. Valid order-of-magnitude only
notes: Thermal proxy — not a thermodynamic simulation. alpha_abs here is the effective multiphoton absorption coefficient in the focal volume which is not the linear absorption coefficient

equation_name: Simulated top-view image by PSF convolution
equation_text: I_sim(x y) = V(x y z_focus) conv PSF(x y) where PSF = Gaussian of width sigma = lambda_mic/(2*NA_mic)
inputs_required: V(x y z_focus) [modification proxy volume cross-section]; lambda_mic [m]; NA_mic [dimensionless]
calibration_required: no — but PSF sigma should be calibrated for actual microscope
validity_limits: Assumes Gaussian PSF (not the full Airy disk); no aberrations; no coherent imaging effects; no material-contrast model
notes: Simulated image is spatial extent proxy only — contrast not calibrated. Upgrade to calibrated_material_prediction requires measured PSF and contrast calibration

equation_name: Step-index or graded-index mode solver — V-number and mode size
equation_text: V = (2*pi/lambda) * r_core * sqrt(n_core^2 - n_clad^2) approx (2*pi/lambda) * r_core * sqrt(2 * n_core * delta_n)
inputs_required: lambda [m]; r_core [m]; n_core [dimensionless]; delta_n [dimensionless index change]
outputs_produced: V-number [dimensionless]; mode field diameter; number of guided modes; cutoff condition
calibration_required: yes — delta_n and r_core must be measured
validity_limits: Valid for step-index profile approximation. Graded profiles require full numerical BPM. Single-mode condition V < 2.405
notes: Mode predictions are order-of-magnitude only until Δn is calibrated. Single-mode criterion: V < 2.405 — applies to step-index guide
